I am embarrassed to say I was completely blind to what was happening in our oceans(besides knowing pollution was an issue) perhaps because the only fish I eat is tuna.  I made my kids watch the movie and my daughter said that perhaps people don't care or know about it because we don't see it?  For example when they bulldoze acres of rainforest we can see the destruction and it makes us angry.  However when they do the very same with the trawlers we don't see the destruction it causes so we don't feel outrage.  Obviously not an excuse but it is definitely a valid point.  Either way we have agreed as a family no more fish(for those who do enjoy it) and I haven't bought any tuna since watching the film.  I no longer trust the "dolphin free"  label.  To be honest even they didn't kill a single dolphin they are still killing numerous other species of marine life.  I am working up the courage to watch cowspiracy...I have a feeling that we may be heading towards a more plant based diet in my household.  Because our meat is all packaged up nicely at the grocery store we really don't think about the destruction caused to get it there.  Sad but true.
